name: @gcu/shp
description: ESRI Shapefile reader/writer (.shp + .shx + .dbf + .prj) over GeoJSON-shaped features. Points, lines, polygons with holes, Z (M dropped), dBASE attributes with .cpg encodings, and a one-word read of the .prj (geographic / projected / local). Zero-dependency, first-party, never reprojects.
author: Arthur Endlein Correia
